newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds little changed and quiet.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds little changed and quiet.

text.p: UK meals and feeds prices were little changed on Wednesday as the market remained in the doldrums.
"There is next to no offtake from compounds which means the rest of us are having a very thin time," said one broker.
In light trading home produced corn gluten feed pellets traded at 108 stg a tonne for spot on the resale market ex-store Tilbury.
On the south coast a small load of high protein soymeal was done at 208 stg for spot.
